final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts` and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts`, and all three tests in `tests/ports.test.ts` now pass.

I also checked the README examples and the error cases by hand: the `80, 443,8080 - 8090,8091` example normalizes to `80,443,8080-8091`, and `10-20,21-30` merges while `10-20,22-30` stays split. Malformed input such as `80,,443`, `90-80`, `65536` and `+80` throws. I did not commit the change.
